bloodlines.arcana: Whenever you apply a metamagic feat that raises a spell's slot by at least one level, increase that spell's save DC by 1. This does not stack with itself and does not apply to Heighten Spell.

powers.name: Arcane Bond
powers.summary: Gain a familiar or bonded object as a wizard of your sorcerer level. Sorcerer and wizard levels stack for the bond, and a bonded item can cast one spell known once per day.

powers.name: Metamagic Adept
powers.summary: Apply a known metamagic feat without increasing a spontaneous spell's casting time. Use once per day at 3rd level, plus once per four additional sorcerer levels, up to five times at 19th.

powers.name: New Arcana
powers.summary: Add one sorcerer/wizard spell you can cast to your spells known, adding another at 13th and 17th levels.

powers.name: School Power
powers.summary: Choose one school of magic and increase the save DC of your spells from that school by 2, stacking with Spell Focus.

powers.name: Arcane Apotheosis
powers.summary: Apply known metamagic without increasing casting time, and expend spell slots in place of charges when using charged magic items.

bloodlines.arcana: Creatures you conjure with summoning-subschooled spells gain DR/evil equal to half your sorcerer level, minimum 1. This does not stack with their other damage reduction.

powers.name: Heavenly Fire
powers.summary: Make a ranged touch ray within 30 feet 3 + Charisma modifier times per day. It deals divine damage to evil creatures, heals good creatures once per day each, and has no effect on neutral creatures.

powers.name: Celestial Resistances
powers.summary: Gain acid resistance 5 and cold resistance 5, increasing both to 10 at 9th level.

powers.name: Wings of Heaven
powers.summary: Grow feathery wings and fly at 60 feet with good maneuverability for minutes per day equal to sorcerer level, spent in 1-minute increments.

powers.name: Conviction
powers.summary: Once per day, reroll one ability check, attack roll, skill check, or saving throw before the result is revealed, taking the second result.

powers.name: Ascension
powers.summary: Gain immunity to acid, cold, and petrification; electricity and fire resistance 10; +4 against poison; unlimited Wings of Heaven; and the ability to speak with any creature that has a language.
